caption: Two identical ice cubes sit side by side, one on a thick metal block and one on a plastic block, and the cube on the metal is melting faster in a spreading pool.

sa.check: Two ice cubes sit side by side, one on a metal block and one on a plastic block.
The cube on the metal is melting: it is rounder and lower.
A pool spreads under the cube on the metal.
The pool on the metal block is the larger of the two.

pc.expect: The difference shows on the metal side: the cube on the metal rounds off and its pool grows more than the cube on the plastic.
pc.fail: The cube on the plastic rounds off and pools while the cube on the metal stays sharp; or both cubes melt alike with one plainly on metal and one on plastic; or the pool under the plastic block grows while the metal stays dry.

pc.expect: Both cubes only shrink and round off, neither grows back, and the difference between them does not reverse.
pc.fail: A cube regains a sharp corner; or a pool draws back into its cube; or the cube on the metal ends sharper than the cube on the plastic after being rounder; or a cube freezes solid again on its block.

pc.expect: Each pool spreads outward on its block's flat top and runs off the edges.
pc.fail: A pool climbs its block's side and stays above the top; or meltwater travels uphill; or a drop leaves a block and rises.

pc.expect: The cubes stay hard solids that keep their corners until those corners melt away, and the melt is a thin film on each block.
pc.fail: A cube sags or bends as a soft lump; or a cube crumbles to dry powder; or a pool stands as a dome on its block; or a cube smears across its block as it shrinks.

pc.expect: Two cubes and two blocks; water comes only from the cubes.
pc.fail: A third cube appears; or a cube vanishes in a single frame while still large; or water appears on a block with no cube on it; or a cube passes into its block.

pc.expect: The blocks' surfaces away from the water and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A block changes colour; or the metal block's finish changes pattern; or items around the blocks rearrange.
